items.title: Peter Ecklund interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 14, 1998
items.q: He plays kind of like George Lewis.

ctx.x: Oh, that’s interesting. And that was pretty straight forward Dixieland?

That was New Orleans revival style, that’s what he likes. He plays kind of like George Lewis. That’s the music I heard in the late ‘60s when I was in college. I made a lot of trips to New Orleans on vacations and heard some of that music when it was still pretty decent, at Preservation Hall and all that, and that was really a great experience.
Well I want to come back to that for a minute, but we’re just at the beginning of your week, and you’ve done that gig, and what’s next on your calendar?
